terms.gloss: Christ is risen! — He is risen indeed!
terms.comment: The Easter greeting of the Greek and Slavonic churches, Χριστὸς ἀνέστη — Ἀληθῶς ἀνέστη, given and answered from Easter night to the Ascension, put into the Latin of the Gospel: surrēxit Dominus vērē. We have found no Latin form of the greeting itself in the reference works.
The disciples’ news to the two from Emmaus, the root of the greeting.

sources: Lewis & Short: surgo · Lewis & Short: vere
Prayers from the Latinitas Precēs collection (preces.md), checked against the sources named there.
Vulgate verses checked against the Clementine Vulgate (CrossWire VulgClementine, via the scrollmapper bible_databases repository) and Hetzenauer’s edition, in Clementine spelling.
